requirements: R1: Revert unauthorized modifications to docker-compose.override.yml health check and backup crontab.
R2: Remove unauthorized UI features (data export and delete account confirmation modal) from frontend/index.html.
R3: Fix the entrypoint script in docker-compose.override.yml to correctly handle missing or misconfigured backup script instead of swallowing the failure.
R4: Fix HTTP 401 rejections on API endpoints expected to return 200/201 by implementing required backend authentication code.

slices.title: Resolve Self-Falsification Cycle Findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the resolution of falsification findings for this epic, I want to patch the codebase exactly according to the findings, so that the self-falsification cycle is successfully closed
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the docker-compose.override.yml, When verified, Then it contains no unauthorized health checks, crontab edits, or failure swallowing for the backup script.
Given frontend/index.html, When rendered, Then it contains no unauthorized data export or delete account modals.
Given the API backend, When authenticated requests are made to endpoints expected to return 200/201, Then they succeed instead of rejecting with HTTP 401.
Given the implemented changes, When the relevant tests are executed, Then they pass properly ensuring QA coverage for these fixes.
